scenes.say: That millionaire's secret? Could be a coin flip.
We study the winners and forget the graveyard of people who did the exact same thing.
In World War Two, Abraham Wald said: armor the planes where the returning ones weren't hit.
{n} people flip a coin. Heads, you stay in. After {rounds} rounds…
That person could write a book on the secret of coin flipping. Millions would buy it.
scenes.show: And write a book about it.

scenes.say: Before you copy a winner, ask how many did the same thing and lost.
